interfaces.name: ood_spec
interfaces.constraints: Mapping with population, targets, validation, validation_targets, branch, options, initialization_path and output_directory. Populations are validated ImagePopulation objects; targets are aligned integer class indices. Training length must divide batch size. Options contain exactly epochs, batch_size, seed, mean, std, warmup_steps, first_schedule_index and checkpoint_policy. Initialization is an explicit trusted local standard B7 checkpoint. Normalization, schedule and selected checkpoint are caller policies, not authenticated winner settings. Branch must be ood; targets are in [0,1295).

interfaces.name: state
interfaces.constraints: Trusted local checkpoint state with kind, path, training-time SHA256, metrics and policy. B7 adds branch and normalization; generator adds its associated font-classifier state. Inference verifies checkpoint bytes before fresh tensor-only loading. Paths require a provisioned private filesystem; model checkpoints do not resume optimizer/RNG history.
